targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM findings f JOIN scan_results sr ON sr.id = f.scan_result_id WHERE sr.id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM scan_results GROUP BY sbom_id) AND f.vex_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_affected'
SELECT sum(critical_count) FROM scan_results WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM scan_results GROUP BY sbom_id)

panels.title: Findings by severity, latest scan per image

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.repository, i.tag, sr.critical_count AS critical, sr.high_count AS high, sr.medium_count AS medium, sr.low_count AS low, sr.negligible_count AS negligible, sr.scanned_at FROM scan_results sr JOIN sboms s ON s.id = sr.sbom_id JOIN images i ON i.id = s.image_id WHERE sr.id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM scan_results GROUP BY sbom_id) ORDER BY sr.critical_count DESC, sr.high_count DESC

panels.title: Most common CVEs across all tracked images

targets.rawSql: SELECT vulnerability_id, severity, count(DISTINCT image_id) AS affected_images FROM findings GROUP BY vulnerability_id, severity ORDER BY affected_images DESC LIMIT 25
